description.value: A group-only campsite set in a sheltered cove right on the west shore of Harrison Lake, with a sandy beach well-suited for swimming; accessed via 7.9 km of forest service road and available by advance reservation only, with no walk-in option.

address.value: 16440 Morris Valley Road, Agassiz, BC V0M1A1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a group-only campsite on Harrison Lake requiring advance online reservation, with a maximum of 50 people. It accommodates large trailers and tents but has no first-come-first-serve option, making it unsuitable for individual touring cyclists. OSM tags indicate no drinking water, no showers, no power, and no laundry, but since the website does not explicitly address these amenities, they are marked null. Reservations are confirmed true from the website ('available by On-line Reservations Only').
concerns: Group-only site: individual touring cyclists cannot book this campsite
Address listed (16440 Morris Valley Road, Agassiz) is the operator's office, not the campsite location; the actual site is ~7.9 km up Sts'ailes Forest Service Road on Harrison Lake
No drinking water, showers, or electrical power per OSM tags — remote recreation site with minimal amenities
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a group-only site (max 50 people) requiring advance online reservation with no first-come-first-serve option. Individual touring cyclists cannot use it, though an organized cycling group could potentially book it. Its suitability for a WWC directory listing is ambiguous.
enrichment_extras.notes: Also known as Wolf Lake Group Site (OSM alt_name). Operated by West Harrison Reservations on behalf of RST BC in partnership with Sts'ailes First Nations.
